ne: यो... मेरो पसल हो? यो त हामीले खोलेको दिन जस्तै देखिन्छ।

keys: It doesn't leak anymore. I am a genius.
en: It doesn't leak anymore. I am a genius.
ne: अब यो चुहिंदैन। म त कमाल रहेछु।

keys: It needs water twice a week. Bhai, that's your job.
en: It needs water twice a week. Bhai, that's your job.
ne: यसलाई हप्तामा दुईपल्ट पानी चाहिन्छ। भाइ, यो तिम्रो काम हो।

keys: It opens all the way! And it doesn't scream anymore!
en: It opens all the way! And it doesn't scream anymore!
ne: यो पूरै खुल्छ! र अब यसले कराउँदैन!

keys: It shines! I can see my face in it.
en: It shines! I can see my face in it.
ne: यो टल्कियो! म यसमा मेरो अनुहार देख्न सक्छु।
त्यो एकपल्ट मात्र भएको हो, दिदी।

keys: It works! I mean... of course it works. Kanchha Dai never fails.
en: It works! I mean... of course it works. Kanchha Dai never fails.
ne: यो काम गर्छ! मेरो मतलब... अवश्य काम गर्छ। कान्छा दाइ कहिल्यै चुक्दैनन्।

keys: It would be, if the railing wasn't held up by a broom.
en: It would be, if the railing wasn't held up by a broom.
ne: हुन्थ्यो, यदि रेलिङ कुचोले थामिएको नभइदिएको भए।

keys: It's flying! Didi, look, it's FLYING!
en: It's flying! Didi, look, it's FLYING!
ne: यो उडिरहेको छ! दिदी, हेर, यो उडिरहेको छ!

keys: It's just dust, Bhai. And boxes. And... a lot of boxes.
en: It's just dust, Bhai. And boxes. And... a lot of boxes.
ne: यो त धुलो मात्र हो, भाइ। र बाकसहरू। र... धेरै बाकसहरू।

keys: It's like the lanterns are floating!
en: It's like the lanterns are floating!
ne: लालटिनहरू त हावामा उडिरहेका जस्तै छन्!

keys: It's like the sky is wearing a necklace!
en: It's like the sky is wearing a necklace!

keys: It's so bright! I'll need my sunglasses for tea.
en: It's so bright! I'll need my sunglasses for tea.
ne: यो त एकदमै उज्यालो छ! चिया खाँदा मलाई धुलो चस्मा चाहिने भो।

keys: It's so peaceful here. Just the water and the hills.
en: It's so peaceful here. Just the water and the hills.
ne: यहाँ एकदमै शान्त छ। केवल पानी र पहाडहरू।

keys: It's the best S in Kathmandu, Bhai.
en: It's the best S in Kathmandu, Bhai.
ne: यो काठमाडौंकै सबैभन्दा राम्रो S हो, भाइ।

keys: Just like the Tihar nights of my childhood.
en: Just like the Tihar nights of my childhood.
ne: ठीक मेरो बाल्यकालका तिहारका रातहरू जस्तै।

keys: Kanchha Dai at your service! Wires, bulbs, anything electric.
en: Kanchha Dai at your service! Wires, bulbs, anything electric.
ne: कान्छा दाइ सेवामा हाजिर! तार, बल्ब, जुनसुकै बिजुलीको काम।

keys: Ke garne, babu. My knees aren't what they were. The old pasal needs young hands.
en: Ke garne, babu. My knees aren't what they were. The old pasal needs young hands.
ne: के गर्ने, बाबु। मेरा घुँडा अब पहिले जस्ता छैनन्। पुरानो पसललाई जवान हातहरू चाहिन्छ।

keys: Leave the heavy stuff to me! I lift weights. Well, I lifted one, once.
en: Leave the heavy stuff to me! I lift weights. Well, I lifted one, once.
ne: गह्रुंगो काम मलाई छाडिदेऊ! म तौल उठाउँछु। हो, एकपल्ट एउटा उठाएको थिएँ।

keys: Let there be light! And let it not flicker, please.
en: Let there be light! And let it not flicker, please.
ne: उज्यालो होस्! र कृपया यो भिरभिरे नहोस्।

keys: Look at it! Customers are stopping just to take photos.
en: Look at it! Customers are stopping just to take photos.
ne: यसलाई हेर! ग्राहकहरू फोटो खिच्नकै लागि रोकिन्छन्।

keys: Look how it flutters in the wind!
en: Look how it flutters in the wind!

keys: Look who's brave now that the webs are gone.
en: Look who's brave now that the webs are gone.
ne: हेर त, जालो हटेपछि कति हिम्मतिलो भएछौ।

keys: Maya nani! You came home! Look at you, all grown up.
en: Maya nani! You came home! Look at you, all grown up.
ne: माया नानी! तिमी घर आयौ! हेर त, कति ठूली भइसकेकी।

keys: Maya swept the whole street? Even in front of MY stall?
en: Maya swept the whole street? Even in front of MY stall?
ne: मायाले सारा सडक बढारी? मेरो पसलअगाडि पनि?

keys: Maya! I could smell the paint from my tea stall. It looks wonderful!
en: Maya! I could smell the paint from my tea stall. It looks wonderful!
ne: माया! मेरो चिया पसलबाटै मैले रङको गन्ध पाएँ। यो त एकदमै राम्रो देखिन्छ!

keys: Maya... the shop is a pile of stones. Literally.
en: Maya... the shop is a pile of stones. Literally.
ne: माया... पसल त ढुङ्गाको थुप्रो मात्र भएको छ। साँच्चै।

keys: My books, Hajurama's recipes and Bhai's comics. Perfect.
en: My books, Hajurama's recipes and Bhai's comics. Perfect.
ne: मेरा किताबहरू, हजुरआमाका रेसिपीहरू र भाइका कमिक्स। एकदमै उत्तम।

keys: My kite went higher than the neighbour's!
en: My kite went higher than the neighbour's!
ne: मेरो चङ्गा छिमेकीको भन्दा उच्च गयो!

keys: My old sign! I painted those letters myself, before your mother was born.
en: My old sign! I painted those letters myself, before your mother was born.
ne: मेरो पुरानो साइनबोर्ड! मैले ती अक्षरहरू आफैं रङ्गेको हुँ, तिम्री आमा जन्मिनुभन्दा पहिले।

keys: My stall! It's... it's beautiful! Free tea for a month!
en: My stall! It's... it's beautiful! Free tea for a month!
ne: मेरो पसल! यो... यो त सुन्दर छ! एक महिना सित्तैंको चिया!

keys: Next stop: the mountains! Trekkers love sweets!
en: Next stop: the mountains! Trekkers love sweets!
ne: अर्को गन्तव्य: हिमाल! ट्रेकरहरूलाई मिठाई मनपर्छ!

keys: No more muddy shoes in my stall!
en: No more muddy shoes in my stall!
ne: अब मेरो पसलमा हिलाम्मे जुत्ता हुँदैन!

keys: No more tripping. Safe steps, happy customers.
en: No more tripping. Safe steps, happy customers.
ne: अब लड्नु पर्दैन। सुरक्षित खुट्किला, खुसी ग्राहक।

keys: No more wobbly corner. Hajurama can stop warning everyone.
en: No more wobbly corner. Hajurama can stop warning everyone.
ne: अब लरबराउने कुना छैन। हजुरआमाले सबैलाई सचेत गराउनु पर्दैन।

keys: Now all the gossip has a proper home.
en: Now all the gossip has a proper home.
ne: अब सबै गफगाफको आफ्नै ठाउँ भयो।

keys: Now Bhai can fly his kite without giving me a heart attack.
en: Now Bhai can fly his kite without giving me a heart attack.
ne: अब भाइले मलाई डर नदिएर चङ्गा उडाउन सक्छ।

keys: Now I know it's not dinner time. Again.
en: Now I know it's not dinner time. Again.
ne: अब मलाई थाहा भो, यो खानाको समय होइन। फेरि।

keys: Now my customers can wait for tea in your shade. Very good business, Maya!
en: Now my customers can wait for tea in your shade. Very good business, Maya!
ne: अब मेरा ग्राहकले तिम्रो छायामा चिया पर्खन सक्छन्। एकदमै राम्रो व्यापार, माया!

keys: Now my stall is part of the festival too!
en: Now my stall is part of the festival too!
ne: अब मेरो पसल पनि चाडको हिस्सा भयो!

keys: Now this is a kitchen worth cooking in!
en: Now this is a kitchen worth cooking in!
ne: अब यो त पकाउन लायकको भान्सा भयो!

keys: Oho! The neighbours will think we've become rich.
en: Oho! The neighbours will think we've become rich.
ne: ओहो! छिमेकीहरूले हामी धनी भइसक्यौं भनेर सोच्नेछन्।

keys: Oho, my lucky cash box! Thirty years and it still rattles.
en: Oho, my lucky cash box! Thirty years and it still rattles.
ne: ओहो, मेरो भाग्यमानी पैसा बाकस! तीस वर्ष भइसक्यो, अझै खटखटिन्छ।

keys: On a clear day you can see all the way to the mountains.
en: On a clear day you can see all the way to the mountains.

keys: On clear mornings they shine like sugar, babu.
en: On clear mornings they shine like sugar, babu.
ne: सफा बिहानहरूमा तिनीहरू चिनी जस्तै टल्किन्छन्, बाबु।

keys: One jar at a time, Bhai. One jar at a time.
en: One jar at a time, Bhai. One jar at a time.
ne: एक पल्टमा एक बट्टा, भाइ। एक पल्टमा एक बट्टा।

keys: One room at a time, Bhai. First, the kitchen!
en: One room at a time, Bhai. First, the kitchen!
ne: एक पल्टमा एक कोठा, भाइ। पहिले, भान्सा!

keys: Oof. From out here the pasal looks even sadder.
en: Oof. From out here the pasal looks even sadder.
ne: ओफ। यहाँबाट हेर्दा पसल अझ दुखद देखिन्छ।

keys: Ooh, fancy! Are you expecting guests?
en: Ooh, fancy! Are you expecting guests?
ne: ओहो, कति चिटिक्क! पाहुना आउँदैछन् कि क्या हो?

keys: Open doors, open hearts. That's Tihar.
en: Open doors, open hearts. That's Tihar.
ne: खुला ढोका, खुला मन। त्यही त तिहार हो।

keys: Our second pasal. Hajurba, this one's for you.
en: Our second pasal. Hajurba, this one's for you.
ne: हाम्रो दोस्रो पसल। हजुरबा, यो तपाईंकै लागि हो।

keys: People keep asking if you'll open another shop, Maya.
en: People keep asking if you'll open another shop, Maya.
ne: मानिसहरूले तिमी अर्को पसल खोल्छौ कि भनेर सोधिरहन्छन्, माया।

keys: Pretty! Where did you get that cloth?
en: Pretty! Where did you get that cloth?

keys: Ramro! I can see the wood again!
en: Ramro! I can see the wood again!
ne: राम्रो! मैले फेरि काठ देख्न सकेँ!

keys: Rest your legs, have a Lapsi candy!
en: Rest your legs, have a Lapsi candy!
ne: आफ्ना खुट्टा आराम गर, लप्सी मिठाई खाऊ!

keys: Rich in paint, Hajurama. That's a start.
en: Rich in paint, Hajurama. That's a start.
ne: रङले भरिपूर्ण, हजुरआमा। यो त सुरुवात हो।

keys: Right. One star, one fix. Where do I start?
en: Right. One star, one fix. Where do I start?
ne: ठीक छ। एक तारा, एक सुधार। कहाँबाट सुरु गरूँ?

keys: Ring ring! Delivery for Sunita Didi! One packet of Pudina!
en: Ring ring! Delivery for Sunita Didi! One packet of Pudina!
ne: घन्टी घन्टी! सुनिता दिदीका लागि डेलिभरी! एक प्याकेट पुदिना!

keys: Roof it is. Bring the kite, Bhai!
en: Roof it is. Bring the kite, Bhai!
ne: छाना नै त। चङ्गा ल्याऊ, भाइ!

keys: Rusty shutters are my specialty! Mostly.
en: Rusty shutters are my specialty! Mostly.
ne: खियाएका सटरहरू मेरो विशेषज्ञता हो! धेरैजसो।

keys: See? Not a single spark. Well, one small spark.
en: See? Not a single spark. Well, one small spark.
ne: देख्यौ? एकचोटि पनि झिल्को आएन। हो, एउटा सानो झिल्को आयो।

keys: Sit with me, nani. Watch the hills turn pink.
en: Sit with me, nani. Watch the hills turn pink.
ne: मसँग बस, नानी। पहाडहरू गुलाबी हुँदै गएको हेर।

keys: So many candies! For the shop. Not for me. Mostly.
en: So many candies! For the shop. Not for me. Mostly.
ne: कति धेरै मिठाई! पसलका लागि। मेरा लागि होइन। धेरैजसो।

keys: So that's where they went. Now you'll have to learn them, nani.
en: So that's where they went. Now you'll have to learn them, nani.
ne: त्यही त हो, ती कहाँ गएछन्। अब तिमीले यिनीहरू सिक्नै पर्छ, नानी।

keys: Solar powered! Even I'm impressed with me.
en: Solar powered! Even I'm impressed with me.
ne: सौर्य ऊर्जाले चल्छ! म आफैं पनि आफूसँग प्रभावित भएँ।

keys: Sorry, Biralo. The rice is not a bed either.
en: Sorry, Biralo. The rice is not a bed either.
ne: माफ गर, बिरालो। चामल पनि ओछ्यान होइन।

keys: Speaking of the tole... the courtyard could use some love, Maya.
en: Speaking of the tole... the courtyard could use some love, Maya.
ne: टोलको कुरा गर्दा... चोकलाई अलिकति मायाको खाँचो छ, माया।

keys: Stone by stone. My back will remember this.
en: Stone by stone. My back will remember this.
ne: ढुङ्गा पछि ढुङ्गा। मेरो ढाडले यो सम्झिरहनेछ।

keys: Sun-dried clothes smell the best. That's a fact.
en: Sun-dried clothes smell the best. That's a fact.
ne: घाममा सुकाएका कपडाको गन्ध सबैभन्दा राम्रो हुन्छ। यो सत्य हो।

keys: Tea and sweets by the lake. Customers will love it.
en: Tea and sweets by the lake. Customers will love it.
ne: तालछेउ चिया र मिठाई। ग्राहकहरूलाई मन पर्नेछ।

keys: Tea, shade and a view. I could stay here all day.
en: Tea, shade and a view. I could stay here all day.
ne: चिया, छाया र दृश्य। म यहाँ दिनभरि बस्न सक्छु।

keys: Thanks, Sunita Didi. Come by for sweets later!
en: Thanks, Sunita Didi. Come by for sweets later!
ne: धन्यवाद, सुनिता दिदी। पछि मिठाई लिन आउनुहोला!

keys: That goat ate my lunch. This is personal.
en: That goat ate my lunch. This is personal.
ne: त्यो बाख्राले मेरो खाजा खायो। यो त व्यक्तिगत कुरा भयो।

keys: That stove has made a thousand cups of tea. It deserves a rest!
en: That stove has made a thousand cups of tea. It deserves a rest!
ne: त्यो चुलोले हजार कप चिया बनाइसक्यो। यसले आराम पाउनुपर्छ!

keys: That's your Hajurba, the day he opened the shop.
en: That's your Hajurba, the day he opened the shop.
ne: त्यो तिम्रो हजुरबा हुनुहुन्छ, उहाँले पसल खोलेको दिन।

keys: The brightest street in all of Kathmandu tonight.
en: The brightest street in all of Kathmandu tonight.
ne: आज राति सारा काठमाडौंकै सबैभन्दा उज्यालो सडक।

keys: The door didn't fall on me! It works!
en: The door didn't fall on me! It works!
ne: ढोका ममाथि खसेन! यो काम गर्छ!

keys: The family room feels like a family room again.
en: The family room feels like a family room again.
ne: परिवार कोठा फेरि परिवार कोठा जस्तै लाग्छ।

keys: The mountains look so close you could touch them.
en: The mountains look so close you could touch them.
ne: हिमालहरू यति नजिक देखिन्छन् कि छुन सकिन्छ जस्तो लाग्छ।

keys: The mountains! I forgot you could see them from in here.
en: The mountains! I forgot you could see them from in here.
ne: हिमालहरू! म बिर्सेकी थिएँ कि यहाँबाट देखिन्छ।

keys: The roof! The best place in the whole house!
en: The roof! The best place in the whole house!
ne: छाना! सारा घरको सबैभन्दा राम्रो ठाउँ!

keys: The ticking crate! It's... a clock?
en: The ticking crate! It's... a clock?
ne: टिक्टिक गर्ने बाकस! यो... घडी हो?

keys: The whole ground floor is done. The counter, the front, the storage room.
en: The whole ground floor is done. The counter, the front, the storage room.
ne: सारा तल्लो तला सकियो। काउन्टर, अगाडिपट्टि, भण्डार कोठा।

keys: The whole street, Bhai. Every light, every garland.
en: The whole street, Bhai. Every light, every garland.
ne: सारा सडक, भाइ। हरेक बत्ती, हरेक माला।

keys: The whole tole chipped in for paint. Let's make it count.
en: The whole tole chipped in for paint. Let's make it count.
ne: सारा टोलले रङका लागि चन्दा दियो। यसलाई सार्थक बनाउँ।

keys: The whole tole is out here! Children, grandparents, even the goats.
en: The whole tole is out here! Children, grandparents, even the goats.
ne: सारा टोल यहाँ बाहिर छ! केटाकेटी, हजुरबा-हजुरआमा, बाख्रा समेत।

keys: Then it goes right where everyone can see it.
en: Then it goes right where everyone can see it.
ne: त्यसोभए यो ठीक त्यहाँ जान्छ जहाँ सबैले देख्न सक्छन्।

keys: Then it has mine. Every jar I sort, the shop gets a little brighter. Promise!
en: Then it has mine. Every jar I sort, the shop gets a little brighter. Promise!
ne: त्यसोभए यसमा मेरो पनि छ। मैले मिलाउने हरेक बट्टासँगै, पसल अलिकति उज्यालो हुन्छ। वाचा!

keys: Then let's find out what's inside. Together!
en: Then let's find out what's inside. Together!
ne: त्यसोभए भित्र के छ पत्ता लगाऔं। सँगसँगै!

keys: Then let's fix it for everyone.
en: Then let's fix it for everyone.

keys: Then let's go outside. Chiya Tole needs to know we're open!
en: Then let's go outside. Chiya Tole needs to know we're open!
ne: त्यसोभए बाहिर जाऊँ। चिया टोललाई थाहा हुनुपर्छ कि हामी खुलेका छौं!

keys: Then that's next. Windows open, Bhai!
en: Then that's next. Windows open, Bhai!
ne: त्यसोभए त्यो नै अर्को हो। झ्यालहरू खोल, भाइ!

keys: Then the mountains it is. Pack warm, everyone.
en: Then the mountains it is. Pack warm, everyone.
ne: त्यसोभए हिमाल नै त। सबैजना न्यानो लुगा राख।

keys: Then we have a lot of stones to work with!
en: Then we have a lot of stones to work with!
ne: त्यसोभए हामीसँग काम गर्न धेरै ढुङ्गा छन्!

keys: There's just one thing. The storage room. Nobody has opened it in years.
en: There's just one thing. The storage room. Nobody has opened it in years.
ne: एउटा मात्र कुरा छ। भण्डार कोठा। वर्षौंदेखि कसैले खोलेको छैन।

keys: There's your mother at your age. Same smile.
en: There's your mother at your age. Same smile.
ne: त्यो तिम्री आमा हो तिम्रै उमेरमा। उस्तै हाँसो।

keys: This is MY room. Well, everyone's room. But mostly mine.
en: This is MY room. Well, everyone's room. But mostly mine.
ne: यो मेरो कोठा हो। हो, सबैको कोठा। तर धेरैजसो मेरो।

keys: This is what a neighbourhood should feel like.
en: This is what a neighbourhood should feel like.

keys: Those are not for digging, Biralo!
en: Those are not for digging, Biralo!

keys: Three shops. A whole family of pasals.
en: Three shops. A whole family of pasals.

keys: Tick, tock. Just like he's still here, keeping us on time.
en: Tick, tock. Just like he's still here, keeping us on time.
ne: टिक, टक। जस्तो उहाँ अझै यहाँ हुनुहुन्छ, हामीलाई समयमा राखिरहनुभएको।

keys: Two shops! I can't believe it.
en: Two shops! I can't believe it.

keys: Two thousand bulbs and not one fuse blown!
en: Two thousand bulbs and not one fuse blown!
ne: दुई हजार बल्ब र एउटा पनि फ्युज नपोलेको!

keys: Upstairs next! Can my room be blue?
en: Upstairs next! Can my room be blue?
ne: अब माथिल्लो तला! मेरो कोठा निलो हुन सक्छ?

keys: Welcome to Chiya Tole's heart, Maya. Or what's left of it.
en: Welcome to Chiya Tole's heart, Maya. Or what's left of it.
ne: चिया टोलको मुटुमा स्वागत छ, माया। वा जो बाँकी छ त्यसमा।

keys: Welcome upstairs, nani. Mind the third step, it squeaks.
en: Welcome upstairs, nani. Mind the third step, it squeaks.
ne: माथिल्लो तलामा स्वागत छ, नानी। तेस्रो खुट्किलामा ध्यान देऊ, त्यो किचकिच गर्छ।

keys: Whoa, Didi! The floor isn't sticky anymore!
en: Whoa, Didi! The floor isn't sticky anymore!
ne: ए दिदी! भुइँ अब टाँसिने भएन!

keys: Whoa, whoa! Too fast! ...Okay, a little slower. Perfect.
en: Whoa, whoa! Too fast! ...Okay, a little slower. Perfect.
ne: ए, ए! धेरै छिटो! ...ठीक छ, अलिकति ढिलो। उत्तम।

keys: Wildflowers, just like where I grew up.
en: Wildflowers, just like where I grew up.
ne: जंगली फूलहरू, ठीक म हुर्केको ठाउँ जस्तै।

keys: With lights, Bhai. Lots and lots of lights.
en: With lights, Bhai. Lots and lots of lights.

keys: You can see the shop sign from up here!
en: You can see the shop sign from up here!
ne: तिमीले यहाँ माथिबाट पसलको साइनबोर्ड देख्न सक्छौ!

keys: You sound just like me fifty years ago!
en: You sound just like me fifty years ago!
ne: तिमी ठीक पचास वर्षअघिको म जस्तै सुनिन्छौ!

keys: Your Hajurba always dreamed of a shop by the water.
en: Your Hajurba always dreamed of a shop by the water.
ne: तिम्रो हजुरबाले सधैं पानीछेउको पसलको सपना देख्नुहुन्थ्यो।

keys: Your Hajurba built that counter. He'd be proud, nani.
en: Your Hajurba built that counter. He'd be proud, nani.
ne: तिम्रो हजुरबाले त्यो काउन्टर बनाउनुभएको हो। उहाँलाई गर्व हुने थियो, नानी।

keys: Your Hajurba is smiling somewhere, nani.
en: Your Hajurba is smiling somewhere, nani.
ne: तिम्रो हजुरबा कतै मुस्कुराइरहनुभएको छ, नानी।

keys: Your Hajurba would have made a speech. A long one.
en: Your Hajurba would have made a speech. A long one.
ne: तिम्रो हजुरबाले त भाषण दिनुहुने थियो। लामै एउटा।
